picks.reasoning: Guiding Hydra: a card you should first-pick nearly every time; better than basically every common and uncommon, but not a card he loves splashing because it suits aggressive two-colour decks. His order from the pack: Hydra, Mindseeker Oculus, Gallia Tragic Host (good aggressive two-drop for black), Marwyn, Bestial Incursion; Stingerquill Voxmancer is 'really bad'.

considered.Mindseeker Oculus: his second pick from the pack: incredible common
considered.Gallia, Tragic Host: really good aggressive two-drop for black decks

quotes: Definitely a card that you should be first picking pretty much every time you see it in packs.

picks.reasoning: No Admittance over Solarium Sentry: Sentry is a two-mana 3/3 that gains life if he is white, but he is not guaranteed to play white and there is no good mono-white follow-up; No Admittance is more flexible and he can abandon the Hydra. He notes the pair is still in the pack so no signal.

considered.Solarium Sentry: incredible if white, but not guaranteed to play white

picks.plan: Open, bias to white or red.
quotes: I think no admittance is just like a better pick here ... I could still abandon the guiding hydra if white doesn't end up being open.

considered.Arni, Humble Scribe: the pick if he were trying his absolute hardest to win now

quotes: Let's try the crater colossus. I feel like it could do some good stuff if we build around it.
